Messages.Author: jnew...@difsol.com
Messages.Body:
Suppose I control the only two ready (untitled) Ishtarri (or any laibon
clan), and the vampires are not the same capacity (say, a 7 and an 8 or
whatever). The older Ishtarri has become the Ishtarri Kholo. Now the
younger is eligible to play Ishtarri Kholo (since he is the oldest
ready untitled Ishtarri). If he does so, the titles will contest.

The second Kholo card will now see an older, ready, untitled Ishtarri
and move accordingly, correct?

This movement would burn the title card already on that Ishtarri and
replace it. Does this "change" in titles result in him "re-earning" the
kholo title and no longer seeing a contest, or is the title still
contested until my next untap phase?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
jnew...@difsol.com wrote:
> Suppose I control the only two ready (untitled) Ishtarri (or any laibon
> clan), and the vampires are not the same capacity (say, a 7 and an 8 or
> whatever). The older Ishtarri has become the Ishtarri Kholo. Now the
> younger is eligible to play Ishtarri Kholo (since he is the oldest
> ready untitled Ishtarri). If he does so, the titles will contest.
>
> The second Kholo card will now see an older, ready, untitled Ishtarri
> and move accordingly, correct?

No. The Kholo cards are title cards -- they follow the fate of the
title.

They are out of play when the title is contested.
